- A bachelor's degree takes four years and at least 128 credits in total. [1]
- Your department may require more credits; its curriculum table has the exact number. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- 12 additional graduation credits are required for students admitted on an equivalent qualification from a foreign, Hong Kong, or Macau school whose graduating grades are equivalent to Taiwan's second year of senior high school. [1]
- Military training and physical education courses do not count toward these 12 additional credits. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- In the first year, you must take at least 16 credits each semester. [1]
- In the fourth year, you must take at least 9 credits each semester. [1]
- If you need to take fewer credits, you must obtain approval from your advisor and department head; otherwise you may be dismissed. [1]

- International students must take the full‑year 5‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” (僑生國文) instead of the local students’ 3‑credit Chinese (A) plus 2‑credit Chinese (B) courses. [1]
- The 5‑credit course is required for all overseas Chinese and international students. [1]
- Local students normally take 3 credits of Chinese (A) and 2 credits of Chinese (B), but international students only take the 5‑credit course. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center replace the freshman Chinese course. [1]
- File for the Chinese course substitution before graduation. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Students are required to take five physical education courses in five semesters (including Freshman PE I, Freshman PE II, and three PE interest electives in the following three semesters), but any course credit earned from these five PE courses does not count toward the number of course credits required for graduation. [2]
- After the five semesters you may take a 1-credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation. [2]
- The five required PE courses are Freshman PE I and II plus three PE interest electives. [2]
- The courses are not counted toward graduation credits. [2]

- A master's degree requires at least 24 credits, not counting thesis credits. [1]
- You must also take at least one graduate course of 1 credit or more at NCU; waived courses do not count. [1]

- Students admitted directly into a doctoral program must complete at least 34 credits, of which at least 18 must be doctoral-level credits (not counting dissertation credits). [1]
- The requirement is specified in National Central University Study Regulations, Article 58. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Apply before the add/drop deadline of your first semester. [1]
- If approved, you will skip both semesters of Freshman English and receive 6 credits that count toward graduation. [1]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- Undergraduates must complete at least 100 service hours on the NCU passport before receiving the degree certificate. [1]
- Check your completed hours on the Service Learning Website (服務學習網) or in the Graduation System (畢業審核系統). [1]
- If you have questions, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [1]

- Service learning is not listed as a graduation condition for master's and doctoral students. [1]
- Graduation requires completion of all required courses and credits, passing the master's or doctoral degree examination, and receiving a satisfactory conduct grade every semester. [1]
- Individual departments may set additional requirements. [1]
- For more information, contact the Center for Service Learning, Office of Student Affairs (學務處服務學習發展中心) at https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/. [1]

- The service-learning course is a zero-credit required course that must be taken in two different semesters. [1]
- The two course numbers of the service-learning courses must be different. [1]
- TOEFL ITP score of 543 (admitted 115 or later) [1]
- BESTEP LR: 170 (admitted 110 or later) [1]

- An English proficiency certificate at CEFR B1 (Threshold) or above is required. [1]
- Acceptable scores include TOEFL iBT: 42; IELTS: 4; TOEIC: 550; GEPT: Intermediate. [2]

- Mon‑Fri 9:00‑17:00 (Taipei time, UTC+8) [2]
